**Build's clean, exit 0.**

Two real bugs from the bump, both in the link stage:

- `[src/core/options.js](src/core/options.js)` — `resolveRetries` read `options.retries`, but the new bundler passes `retryCount`. Fixed the field name.
- `[src/net/retryPolicy.js](src/net/retryPolicy.js)` — `isBackoffEnabled` threw on `undefined`. New config loader leaves unset flags `undefined` instead of `false`. Now treats `undefined` as disabled.

The rest was deprecation noise, unrelated. No further action needed.
